question: Why is fire not called fire in the same way when its heat is restrained by mantra?
premises: Fire is ordinarily identified with its heating power.
Mantra can restrain that manifest power.
The analogy supports inseparability of power and its locus.
inference: Indeed, when restrained by mantra, that is not then called fire in the usual sense.
uncertainties: The verse implies loss of the characteristic function rather than absolute nonexistence.
plain_english: Indeed, in the case of paralysis by mantra, that is not then called fire.
